Even now, many of Fangam's powerful lords{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}are still undecided whether to side with us or with the rebels.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:E783}If we proclaim at home and abroad that the princess is safe, and that the royal line continues as the rightful house of Bradarik,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: we will surely win the support of the wavering lords and the neighboring nations!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: We... no, Fangam! Fangam needs Princess Ashe.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: I beg you, will you fight with us for the sake of Fangam?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...Very well.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Princess!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Carrying on the will of my father, the king, is my duty as princess.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Especially as long as I have loyal retainers like you, still sworn to the house of Bradarik...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}If someone like me will do, I will take on that responsibility.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I accept your request, General.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Thank you, Princess Ashe. {fb:0380}{n}{e0:2107}{spk:0080}{n}I am Ashe Bradarik, daughter of King Bradarik of Fangam.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2207}{spk:0080}{n}I believe you all know that Fangam now faces grave peril at the hands of the traitor Sterens.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2307}{spk:0080}{n}Many of our people have suffered unjust misfortune.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2407}{spk:0080}{n}My father wished above all for the happiness of Fangam's people.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2507}{spk:0080}{n}It grieves me deeply to see that wish trampled.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2607}{spk:0080}{n}But here, many brave warriors have gathered to save the people from their suffering.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:3D07}{spk:0080}{n}In my father's place, I thank you from the bottom of my heart.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2707}{spk:0080}{n}This is not a battle to avenge my father, but a battle to restore peace to our kingdom.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2807}{spk:0080}{n}I ask you all, have courage, and fight without yielding to the monsters Sterens commands.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2907}{spk:0080}{n}Whatever may happen, I will not run from this battle.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2A07}{spk:0080}{n}I will carry on my father's will and fight alongside you to the very end.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2B07}{spk:0080}{n}Surely God blesses what we do.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2C07}{spk:0080}{n}Let us fight together, believing in victory.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:2D07}{spk:0080}{n}For Fangam.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Thank you, Princess Ashe.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: We loved and revered our late king dearly.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: {f7:E783}We are grateful to receive such words from his daughter, Princess Ashe.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: Every one of us here, for the house of Bradarik, for the peace of Fangam,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}General: swears to you, Princess, to fight this battle to the end.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Thank you, everyone. Let us fight together to strike down Sterens, and for peace.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
